requiredAssets.prompt: Match the actual supplied Dino Island website character reference: rounded preschool storybook 2D cartoon, thick dark outlines, emerald green, cream #F6F3EC and gold #b8923a, soft simple shading, large readable shapes. Preserve character face, eyes, hair, uniform, colours and proportions; never redesign the identity. Child-friendly age 3–5. No embedded text, no emoji, no watermark, no realistic scales, no scary teeth, no third-party photo background. Scene: egg studio. Wide landscape 3:2, simple background with clear central interaction space, no characters, soft daytime lighting except night/bedtime scenes. Intended as layered art game background. No text or buttons.

Use case identity-preserve. Input is locked original Dino Island baby. SAME newly hatched baby peeking up with delighted curious face, huge head upright and both tiny hands spread outward at chest height as if resting on the rim of an egg. Full baby body, crouched feet and short tail below, arms clearly visible either side. Do NOT draw an egg or shell: the game will place the child's own decorated shell in front of the lower body. Preserve huge rounded emerald head, large black-white highlighted eyes, round pink cheeks, cream muzzle and plain belly, three gold rounded crest lobes, tiny plump body, gold tail bumps, blunt cream claws, thick black lines and restrained flat 2D shading. Mouth small open happy smile, no teeth. Centered with 8 percent margins, square approximately1024. No text, scenery, props, shell, floor, cast shadow, realistic scales or 3D. Solid pure magenta #FF00FF production matte background for approved removal; no magenta on baby.
requiredAssets.review: Identity and school uniform checked against approved reference. Approved matte removal, 1024 RGBA, cream composite inspected. Completion-only sprite; child-decorated shell stays in front.
